<!-- Generated by Ankus.DocGenerator. -->

Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Provides a checked mutable collection over PostgreSQL's typed native List container.

```csharp
public sealed class PgList<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IReadOnlyList<T>, IReadOnlyCollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IDisposable where T : unmanaged
```

Type parameters:

`T`

Exactly int, uint (OID), PgTransactionId, or nint (opaque pointer).

A default instance is backend-independent NIL until its first allocating mutation.
Bound lists require the owning backend callback and expire when their context resets.
Disposal releases owned containers, never pointer elements. There is no native finalizer.
Safe reads copy cells; unsafe pointers can become invalid after mutation or context cleanup.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

Implements: [IList&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ilist-1), [ICollection&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.icollection-1), [IReadOnlyList&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlylist-1), [IReadOnlyCollection&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlycollection-1), [IEnumerable&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ienumerable-1), [IEnumerable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.ienumerable), [IDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.idisposable)

### Drain(int, int)

Copies and removes a range immediately, repairing the native tail before returning.

```csharp
public T[] Drain(int index, int count)
```

Parameters:

`index` — [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The first cell to remove.

`count` — [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The number of cells to remove, including zero.

Returns: <code>T[]</code>

An independent array of removed values in their original order.

The mutation completes before enumeration of the result; abandoning that enumeration
cannot leave a partially drained container. Emptying the list releases its storage.

<a id="member-0dbed4004c3bdc59"></a>

### GetConsumingEnumerator()

Consumes this wrapper and gives an enumerator its ownership and lifetime obligations.

```csharp
public IEnumerator<T> GetConsumingEnumerator()
```

Returns: [IEnumerator&lt;T&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ienumerator-1)

An enumerator that disposes its list at the end or on early disposal.

The caller must dispose the returned enumerator, including when it is never advanced.
Owned containers are freed; borrowed containers remain with their native owner.
This wrapper becomes unusable immediately after successful transfer.
